Cars only load a new picture for a new track, so every new picture is reported as a new track. The phone and the car must support Bluetooth cover art. The screenshot shows the middle of the screen; with the screen off it stays on the last picture.

With Android Auto, the app shows its own screen with the current hint and the latest warning. Because the app is not from the Play Store: in the Android Auto settings tap the version 10 times, then switch on \"Unknown sources\" in the developer settings (menu at the top right).
